sourceBook.title: The Bag of Wind

storyBibleReview.storySpine: Zoe wants to bring a red kite out of a low tree using a bag that stores wind, but her first gust wedges it farther in.
storyBibleReview.failedAttempt: She releases a strong gust from below the kite; the wind drives the kite deeper into the branch fork.
storyBibleReview.resolution: Zoe moves to the other side and releases a small stored puff through a narrow opening, lifting the kite toward Kit’s waiting hands.
storyBibleReview.magicRule: The separate blue zip pouch stores wind caught from a real breeze while open and sealed by its zipper. Reopening releases the stored wind in the aimed direction; a small opening gives a small puff and closing preserves what remains. It creates no new wind, and no other object is enchanted.

sourceBook.setting: A fictional garden with a low forked apple tree, short lawn and low brick wall, windy afternoon. A removable blue zip pouch holds captured wind only in this story.
props: Blue cloth zip pouch small enough for Zoe’s palm
Red diamond kite with one short white tail
sourceBook.coverBrief: Zoe aims a partly opened blue wind pouch toward a red kite caught in a low tree fork while Kit waits on the other side with both hands ready.

pages.text: Zoe has a magic bag. Open it into the breeze, zip it shut, and the wind stays inside.
pages.imageBrief: Zoe holds the mouth of a blue pouch into a garden breeze; Kit watches beside the low apple tree. Exact continuity: Pouch separate from clothing; this is explicit fantasy; kite lies on grass.
pages.imageAlt: Zoe holds the mouth of a blue pouch into a garden breeze; Kit watches beside the low apple tree.
pages.pageDescription: Zoe holds the mouth of a blue pouch into a garden breeze; Kit watches beside the low apple tree.
pages.state: Pouch separate from clothing; this is explicit fantasy; kite lies on grass.

pages.text: When Zoe opens the bag again, the saved wind rushes out. Kit’s loose kite lifts from the grass.
pages.imageBrief: A gust from the open pouch lifts the red kite a short distance while its spool rests on grass. Exact continuity: First demonstration empties pouch; kite has one short white tail and attached string.
pages.imageAlt: A gust from the open pouch lifts the red kite a short distance while its spool rests on grass.
pages.pageDescription: A gust from the open pouch lifts the red kite a short distance while its spool rests on grass.
pages.state: First demonstration empties pouch; kite has one short white tail and attached string.

pages.text: The kite catches in the tree’s low fork. Kit pulls the string, but the red paper presses against a twig.
pages.imageBrief: Red kite is wedged between two low branches; Kit gently pulls its string from the ground. Exact continuity: Children remain grounded; kite not torn; pouch empty in Zoe’s hand.
pages.imageAlt: Red kite is wedged between two low branches; Kit gently pulls its string from the ground.
pages.pageDescription: Red kite is wedged between two low branches; Kit gently pulls its string from the ground.
pages.state: Children remain grounded; kite not torn; pouch empty in Zoe’s hand.

pages.text: Zoe catches another gust in her bag. “I will blow it out,” she says, standing beneath the kite.
pages.imageBrief: Zoe stands beneath the trapped kite, holding the refilled blue pouch with its zipper now closed. Kit still holds the kite string taut from the ground. Exact continuity: Second stored gust; zipper closed after refilling; Kit has not yet stopped pulling; one moment after the catch.
pages.imageAlt: Zoe stands beneath the trapped kite, holding the refilled blue pouch with its zipper now closed. Kit still holds the kite string taut from the ground.
pages.pageDescription: Zoe stands beneath the trapped kite, holding the refilled blue pouch with its zipper now closed. Kit still holds the kite string taut from the ground.
pages.state: Second stored gust; zipper closed after refilling; Kit has not yet stopped pulling; one moment after the catch.

pages.text: She opens the bag wide. Whoosh! The kite jumps higher and sticks deeper in the fork.
pages.imageBrief: An upward gust pushes the red kite farther into the same fork while Zoe holds the pouch below. Exact continuity: Failed attempt worsens wedge; kite still low enough to reach from opposite ground position.
pages.imageAlt: An upward gust pushes the red kite farther into the same fork while Zoe holds the pouch below.
pages.pageDescription: An upward gust pushes the red kite farther into the same fork while Zoe holds the pouch below.
pages.state: Failed attempt worsens wedge; kite still low enough to reach from opposite ground position.

pages.text: Kit stops pulling. Zoe walks around the tree. From here, she can see a clear gap behind the kite.
pages.imageBrief: Zoe stands opposite her first position, looking through an open gap behind the red kite; Kit holds slack string. Exact continuity: No new magic; changed viewing angle reveals existing exit.
pages.imageAlt: Zoe stands opposite her first position, looking through an open gap behind the red kite; Kit holds slack string.
pages.pageDescription: Zoe stands opposite her first position, looking through an open gap behind the red kite; Kit holds slack string.
pages.state: No new magic; changed viewing angle reveals existing exit.

pages.text: She fills the bag once more and points it through the gap. This time she opens only a tiny corner.
pages.imageBrief: Zoe aims the recharged pouch through the back of the fork, zipper open only a little. Exact continuity: Third gust stored; small opening releases part of it; pouch aimed outward through gap.
pages.imageAlt: Zoe aims the recharged pouch through the back of the fork, zipper open only a little.
pages.pageDescription: Zoe aims the recharged pouch through the back of the fork, zipper open only a little.
pages.state: Third gust stored; small opening releases part of it; pouch aimed outward through gap.

pages.text: A little puff lifts one kite corner. Kit holds out his hands as Zoe lets a second puff escape.
pages.imageBrief: One red kite corner frees from the twig as Kit reaches from the clear side, feet on grass. Exact continuity: Two small releases from same third stored gust; no grabbing sharp twigs.
pages.imageAlt: One red kite corner frees from the twig as Kit reaches from the clear side, feet on grass.
pages.pageDescription: One red kite corner frees from the twig as Kit reaches from the clear side, feet on grass.
pages.state: Two small releases from same third stored gust; no grabbing sharp twigs.

pages.text: The kite slides out into Kit’s hands. Its paper is bent, but there is no hole. Zoe shuts the bag.
pages.imageBrief: Kit catches the freed red kite with both hands while Zoe closes the zipper. Exact continuity: Kite intact but bent along one corner; string remains attached; remaining wind kept inside.
pages.imageAlt: Kit catches the freed red kite with both hands while Zoe closes the zipper.
pages.pageDescription: Kit catches the freed red kite with both hands while Zoe closes the zipper.
pages.state: Kite intact but bent along one corner; string remains attached; remaining wind kept inside.

pages.text: Kit smooths the bent corner. “Save some wind for flying,” he says. Zoe gives the zipped bag a small pat.
pages.imageBrief: Kit smooths the red kite on the grass while Zoe pats her closed blue pouch beside him. Exact continuity: Resolved kite retrieval; bent corner being smoothed; stored puff retained, not a new power.
pages.imageAlt: Kit smooths the red kite on the grass while Zoe pats her closed blue pouch beside him.
pages.pageDescription: Kit smooths the red kite on the grass while Zoe pats her closed blue pouch beside him.
pages.state: Resolved kite retrieval; bent corner being smoothed; stored puff retained, not a new power.

oral.prompt: Why does Zoe’s smaller puff work after her large gust fails?
oral.listenFor: She changes position, uses the clear gap and releases less wind in the direction that frees the kite.

visual.prompt: Where is the opening that lets the kite escape?
visual.lookFor: The branch gap behind the kite aligns with the small outward puff.

sourceBook.levelRationale: App D tracks a seeded magical mechanism, failed force/direction choice, changed viewpoint and two controlled attempts. The concrete repeated pouch state supports a fair spatial inference.
